about_the_game:
About This Game

Prison Fury is a short-session, social-first co-op puzzle platform game for PC. Team up with a friend to navigate mirrored prison levels full of timing, communication, and inventive teamwork. Each round is a compact, replay able experience built around interdependent puzzles — every lever pulled and ball deposited matters. Matches are fast (30–120s), highly social, and designed to create memorable moments with your friend!

Key Features

  • Tight Co-op Design — Two-player pairs occupy complementary sides of each level. Many obstacles require one player to change the other player’s environment, enforcing communication and coordination.

  • Different Puzzle Types — Diverse puzzle sets that demand different skills: pattern memory, timing & choreography, resource placement, and spatial translation (examples below).

  • 2 Player Mode — Primary experience is 2-player cooperative pairs; We want to include, in the future, a party mode that supports 4 players for larger groups and adds chaos. Play online.

Gameplay Mechanics (what players can expect)

Prison Fury’s core loop revolves around short, complementary puzzles where each player’s actions enable the other. Below are representative puzzle types you’ll encounter:

  • Door Puzzle (Color Sequence)

  • Platform Chain Puzzle

  • Ball Puzzle (Deposit & Stop)

  • Sequence Pattern Puzzle (Pattern Transfer)

  • Avoid Obstacle Race

No combat (current version): Gameplay focuses on puzzles, timing, and teamwork. (Future updates may expand mechanics.)

Game Modes

  • Co-op Campaign (2 players): Play through a series of prison stages designed for paired cooperation. Levels are short, designed to be played repeatedly with new strategies and cosmetics to unlock.

  • Party Mode (2–4 players) (future integration): Larger sessions with multiple duos, quicker rounds, and extra chaos for party and streaming play.

What’s Included With Your Purchase

  • Base game with full access to co-op campaign on PC (at launch)

  • Seasonal content track (free and cosmetic premium tiers) with ongoing updates and cosmetic releases

  • Access to future free updates, balance patches, and community-driven content improvements

Post-Launch Roadmap (high level)

Planned post-launch and seasonal updates include: new themed worlds, additional puzzle sets, expanded cosmetic suites (pets, victory animations), quality-of-life improvements, community events, periodic live-ops seasons, and 4-player mode. All roadmap items will be detailed on our official channels and in patch notes.

Want to Help Shape the Game?

We’re actively running playtests and welcome feedback from the community. Join our Discord to sign up for testing, report bugs, and help influence upcoming features.

Wishlist Prison Fury to follow our development and be notified at launch.
